description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mabodala, Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha  District - Cad. Map No.510401 - File No. 16/0149 - Minuwangoda
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land (Parcel Nos. 134, 135, 136, 50, 134, and 371) in Mabodala village, including ownership details, extents, encumbrances, and legal interests. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in Type 4 classification criteria.
